title: Mechanical Experiments
description: Interactive anatomies of four machines in one plate series. Tab 1 - the Swiss lever watch: wind the crown, follow the barrel's energy through the gear train, watch the pallet fork spend it one half-tooth at a time, 28,800 beats an hour. Tab 2 - the bicycle drivetrain: push 172.5 mm cranks, follow the chain from the 50-tooth ring to the 15-tooth cog, feel the freewheel pawls let you coast. Tab 3 - the cassette deck: thread a C-60 past the play head, let the capstan hold 4.76 cm/s while the packs trade places and the reels drift between 18.5 and 43.3 rpm. Tab 4 - the chairlift: one rope looped between two stations, a 4.5 m bullwheel pulling it at 5 m/s, sheave batteries carrying it over the towers, and a detachable grip that lets each chair creep through the station while the rope never slows. Live gauges, true numbers, honest simplifications.
